en.title: Publishing Tournament Pages
en.excerpt: How to transition tournaments from draft to published status, manage public visibility, and share registration links.
en.content:
Pre-Publishing Verification Checklist

Before making your tournament accessible to the public, verify the following configuration items:

  • At least one competition category has been created with entry fees and quota limits.
  • Contact information (WhatsApp and email) is active and verified.
  • Registration start and end dates are set correctly in local time (WIB/UTC+7).
  • Promotional banner image and event description are clearly formatted.

Activating Public Visibility

To publish the event:

  1. Open your tournament in the Organizer Dashboard.
  2. In the top action bar, switch the status toggle from Draft to Published.
  3. Confirm the publication modal. Your event is immediately indexed in public search and appears on archeris.net/tournaments.

Custom Tournament URLs & Sharing

Each published event receives a unique canonical URL (e.g., archeris.net/tournaments/jakarta-open-2026). Copy this link to distribute across WhatsApp groups, club newsletters, and social media platforms.

Manually Closing Registrations

While registration closes automatically on the set end date, organizers can click Close Registration at any time if field capacity is reached ahead of schedule.
